PriceThisThing

Privacy Policy

Last updated November 15, 2026

PriceThisThing is a product of Crawford Marketing, operated by Karl Crawford ("we," "us"). This policy explains what information we collect through PriceThisThing, how it's used, and your choices.

What we collect

  • Email address, when you sign in, so we can send sign-in codes and connect your plan to you.
  • Photos and item details you submit, so we can produce your valuation.
  • Valuation results, such as the item description and estimated prices.
  • Usage information: how many valuations you've used, plus a random ID for your device, your device type, and when you last opened the app. We use this to apply free and plan limits.
  • Feedback you choose to send, including survey answers.
  • Payment status from Stripe: your Stripe customer ID, which plan you have, and whether it's active. We never receive your full card number.

How we use it

To provide valuations, apply plan limits, sign you in, process payments, answer support requests, and improve the Service. We don't sell your information, and we don't use it for advertising.

Who processes it for us

We use these service providers, only to run the Service:

  • Anthropic: the AI that analyzes your photos and details to produce valuations.
  • Stripe: payment processing.
  • Netlify: website hosting and data storage.
  • Resend: sending sign-in code emails.

How long we keep it

Photos are deleted automatically when a valuation finishes. Photos from a valuation that doesn't finish may be kept until our next cleanup. Your account, plan history, valuation results, and feedback are kept while you use the Service. You can ask us to delete your account and information at any time, except records we must keep for tax or legal reasons.

Information stored on your device

The app stores a random device ID and your sign-in session in your browser's storage. Clearing your browser data signs you out.

Children

The Service isn't intended for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

Your choices

To see, correct, or delete your information, email support@pricethisthing.com from the address on your account.

Changes

If we change this policy in a significant way, we'll tell you in the app or by email.

Contact

support@pricethisthing.com
